title: Session and Role Transition
summary: Connect session lifecycle, function-level authorization, and business workflow state to a reusable research method.
objectives: Explain session validity separately from role permission.
Test logout, rotation, and function boundaries with controls.
traditional_lens: Model token lifecycle, role transitions, permitted functions, and workflow preconditions.
ai_lens: Prevent remembered context, prior grants, or model suggestions from persisting authority after state changes.
